sentences.text: Run every Claude Code session from one native Mac window.
One orchestrator for each project, with live status for every worker.
Each worker gets its own git worktree, so parallel work never collides.
Chat with any session, right in the app.
There is no terminal to manage.
When a worker wants to commit or run a tool, a card appears.
Review it, then approve with one click.
